body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #6, company drawn at random (seed 20261203) from IT / Chemicals / Capital Goods names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.4 (naive base rate 0.63) that: Harsha Engineers FY27 consolidated net profit is >= Rs 180 cr (+16%). Our reasoning: H1 Rs 82.41 cr (+10.8%); H2 needs Rs 97.6 cr (+21% vs H2 FY26 Rs 80.8 cr); Advantek guided H2-positive, foreign losses shrinking; Romania restructuring one-offs and soft Q3 cut against; central ~Rs 175 cr. Naive base: 4 of 6 FYs (FY21-26) had PAT growth >= 16% (Laplace 5/8 = 0.625) [SCR]. Resolution: YES if consolidated profit for the period (ProfitLossForPeriod, incl. minority, as first reported) for FY ended 31-Mar-2027 is >= Rs 180 cr. Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (consolidated) / screener consolidated quarterly. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
